attributes.law_screen: claim.law.offsetof-rename-preserves-protected-web (applied as the PRIMARY technique throughout: every conversion kept the original raw pointer's type and a single additive expression, never introducing a typed intermediate) -- claim.law.dead-offset-shadow-removal-safe (screened and tried once: EnterTower's reqOffset shadow variable over lbl_80124D94[3] looked like a textbook case, but converting to lbl_80124D94[j] and dropping reqOffset REGRESSED real 321->323 with a DIFFERS opcode multiset - mtctr/addi counted-loop form lost - reverted; recorded as a negative data point, this specific loop's other live loop variables (recordOffset, count) apparently make MWCC choose a different loop-compilation strategy than the law's original evidence) -- claim.law.declared-alias-vs-repeated-cast / claim.law.multifield-alias-defeats-indexed-addressing / claim.law.pointer-walk-array-index-regression / claim.law.recomputed-index-array-form-safe (screened: deliberately never introduced a typed intermediate pointer or switched a walked/indexed base to array-style indexing anywhere in this pass, so these hazard laws were not triggered by design) -- claim.law.lwzu-idiom-web-retention (screened: towerLevelStatus's save+=level*2 accumulator and sumnerCheckLevelUp's levelSlot+=76 lwzu-adjacent idiom were both respelled ONLY at the constant (76 -> offsetof(TowerMsgState,levelUpLevel)), the accumulator's own type/web left untouched - consistent with the law) -- claim.law.scalar-read-write-lfsu-mixed-form (screened: no adjacent raw-read/named-write pairs on the same field were found in this TU) -- claim.law.offsetof-rename-array-member-boundary (screened: no raw offset on an array-typed struct MEMBER via -> was converted; all offsetof() sites here are on plain pointer locals/parameters) -- claim.law.offsetof-rename-isolated-site-outlier (heeded: every batch was gated individually rather than trusting a spot-check, per this law's caution) -- claim.law.walked-base-symbol-identity (not applicable: no dual-symbol overlap, only local pointer-plus-constant arithmetic) -- claim.law.large-fn-batch-fuzzy-can-mask-subfield-regression (not applicable: no function in this TU exceeds the ~4000-insn fuzzy-arbitration threshold; fndiff real/insn-count was checked via defake_gate on every batch regardless)
